parts.stem:
Scarlett wants to test if sunlight is necessary for photosynthesis.

Put her experiment steps in the correct order.

items.value: Collect two green plants in plant pots.
Leave both plants for two days and water them regularly.
Compare the appearance of the two plants.
Place a paper bag with holes over one.

correct_answer: Collect two green plants in plant pots.
Place a paper bag with holes over one.
Leave both plants for two days and water them regularly.
Compare the appearance of the two plants.
